text.text_excerpt: I have only been here for lunch once, but I have to say my experience was really good, and I'm looking forward to returning. Their prices are very reasonable considering the quality of the food. I got the salad and three roll special. The one that really stuck out was the spicy tuna roll. If I were to order three rolls again, I would get three spicy tunas. It was that good! That said, I do want to try other things on their menu, because it all looked good. Their location is good for both the CBD (another quality lunch spot) and the French Quarter (better than any sushi on that side of Canal). Service was really good. The waitress was quick and kept refilling our glasses. The ambiance was ...

I love Geisha so much! They have a fantastic selection of sushi, special rolls, hand rolls, and other yummies, but they also deliver! Eating in is comfortable and they have a great lunch special. The food is always fresh and delicious. I've eaten-in and ordered delivery numerous times over the years and I can honestly say I've never had a bad experience. They will also wrap your rolls in cucumber instead of rice without making a big deal about it or charging you an arm and a leg (I'm looking at you Tsunami...). If you're looking for sushi downtown, skip the big names and go here. It's always good, easy to get to, and it won't break the bank.

Delicious and consistently fresh. I usually get 2 of the special rolls. The white ninja is one of my favorites. The hand rolls are amazing as well. I'm a bit of a sushi addict and I've had sushi at pretty much every restaurant in the city. Geisha makes my top 3. Honestly the fish just tastes fresh. I frequently order to go from here ( their delivery is super fast as well ) but I also really enjoy dining in. It has a really cute, well put together environment in a cool location downtown and the staff is always really friendly and attentive. The servers and bartenders all seem like they really want you to enjoy your experience. I would like a little bit "livelier" of an atmosphere, but that...
